prova:
intro S hS
  use 0
  constructor
  · exact algebraMap_irreducible (⟨⟨0, by norm_num⟩, by norm_num⟩)
  · constructor
    · exact differentiable_const
    · intro n hn
      use 1
      intro z hz
      have h : derivedSet (S n) = ∅ := hS n
      have h2 : z ∈ derivedSet (S n) := by
        have h3 : z ∈ S n := hz
        exact isClosed_singleton.mpr (by simpa using isClosed_toClosed h3)
      have h4 : z ∈ (∅ : Set ℂ) := by
        simpa [h] using h2
      contradiction
